propositions: Four format changes to a committed shared store require an ADR documenting mixed-version protocol and rollback boundaries: A1 baseline_advanced_at deletion, A2 last_get_pass relocation to get_rotation.json, A3 scalar baseline normalization, and A4-2 prev_snapshot narrowing.

The mixed-version protocol uses chronological max(new, legacy) reads and stops legacy writes only after direct deployment evidence (A2-1 merge, successful descendant reconcile workflow, explicit host-probe refresh with no older process), replacing elapsed-time gates.
Bridge state remains committed on the tickets branch to provide durable state for ephemeral GitHub-hosted runners; off-branch relocation was rejected by epic 6c9c.

Each format change has defined rollback boundaries: A2-1 fully reversible, A3 reversible via idempotent read-path canonicalization, A2-2 supports rollback only to A2-1-or-newer, A4-2 requires recorded forward and reverse corpus evidence.
Assignee field is excluded from normalization because _assignee_candidates requires its raw shape to function correctly.
Measured results show 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB marginal cost after A1 and 218 of 399 identical prev key sets across the migration (session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4).
